summary: The adverb places one event earlier than another. It can also describe something that has yet to happen at the time in view.

senses.definition: Plants have yet to spring up in the field. Samuel has yet to know Yahweh when he first hears the call.
Isaac asks to eat before he dies. David likewise asks for relief before he departs.

note: A deeper verbal derivation is uncertain. The brief pools some spatial forms of other words with this temporal adverb.
